verse.verse_3: (That) We sent it down one night of blessing -- so that We could warn --
verse.verse_4: On which all affairs are sorted out and decided
verse.verse_5: As commands from Us. It is indeed We who send (messengers),
verse.verse_6: A mercy from your Lord. Verily He is all-hearing and all-knowing,
verse.verse_7: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them, if you really do believe.
verse.verse_8: There is no god other than He, who gives you life and death, your Lord and the Lord of your fathers of old.
verse.verse_9: Yet they are lost in doubt and play.
verse.verse_10: So watch for the day when the sky begins to emit clear smoke,
verse.verse_11: Which would envelope mankind. That would be a grievous affliction.
verse.verse_12: "O Lord, take away this torment from us," (they will pray); "we have come to believe."
verse.verse_13: How can a warning benefit them? The Apostle who explained all things clearly had come to them,
verse.verse_14: But they turned away from him, and said: "He is well-instructed, (but) possessed."
verse.verse_15: If We remove the torment a little, you revert back (to misdeeds).
verse.verse_16: The day that We shall seize them with a grievous hold, We will indeed castigate them.
verse.verse_17: We had tried the people of Pharaoh before them. A respected prophet had come to them (saying):
verse.verse_18: "Deliver the creatures of God to me. I am the trusted messenger sent to you.
verse.verse_19: Do not think yourselves to be above God: I have come to you with clear authority.
verse.verse_20: I have taken refuge in my Lord and your Lord against your stoning me to death.
verse.verse_21: If you do not believe in me, leave me alone."
verse.verse_22: Then he called to his Lord: "These are a sinful people."
verse.verse_23: "Journey by night with My devotees," (it was said); "you will certainly be pursued.
verse.verse_24: (Cross and) leave the sea undisturbed. The (pursuing) hosts will surely be drowned,"
verse.verse_25: How many gardens and fountains did they leave behind,
verse.verse_28: Thus it was; and We passed them on to another people.
verse.verse_29: Neither did the heavens weep for them, nor the earth, nor were they granted respite.
verse.verse_30: So We saved the children of Israel from degrading suffering
verse.verse_31: They (had experienced) under the Pharaoh. He was certainly a tyrant, guilty of excess.
verse.verse_32: And We exalted them over the other people knowingly,
verse.verse_33: And sent them tokens to bring out the best in them.
verse.verse_35: "There is no dying for us but once; and we shall not be raised again.
verse.verse_36: So bring our ancestors back, if you are truthful."
verse.verse_37: Are they better than the people of Tubba, and those who had lived before them, whom We destroyed as they were sinners?
verse.verse_38: We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them, out of play.
verse.verse_39: We created them with definite purpose; but most of them do not understand.
verse.verse_40: The Day of Judgement is your promised day of meeting,
verse.verse_41: The day when friend will help no friend in the least, nor will they be helped,
verse.verse_42: Apart from those to whom God is kind. He is all-mighty and all-merciful.
verse.verse_43: The tree of Zaqqum will indeed be
verse.verse_45: It is like pitch. It will fume in the belly
verse.verse_47: "Seize him and drag him into the depths of Hell," (it will be said),
verse.verse_48: "Then pour over his head the torment of scalding water."
verse.verse_49: "Taste it," (they will be told). "You were indeed the mighty and noble!
verse.verse_50: This is certainly what you had denied."
verse.verse_51: Surely those who fear and follow the straight path will be in a place of peace and security
verse.verse_52: In the midst of gardens and of springs,
verse.verse_53: Dressed in brocade and shot silk, facing one another.
verse.verse_54: Just like that. We shall pair them with companions with large black eyes.
verse.verse_55: They will call for every kind of fruit with satisfaction.
verse.verse_56: There they will not know any death apart from the first death they had died, and will be kept safe from the torment of Hell
verse.verse_57: By the beneficence of your Lord. This will be the great success.
verse.verse_58: Therefore We have made this (Qur'an) easy in your tongue. They may haply take a warning.
verse.verse_59: So you wait. They are also waiting.
